events.text: Root-caused: two ~740KB megashader-class WGSL modules (Effect fill catalog + painted-ground formula, both composing all 410 materials) compile per boot ~95s each on the render thread. Historically absorbed by RADV's disk cache; cache stopped absorbing recently. Disk at 100% (886MB free) kills Mesa cache writes silently; wgpu-native repin Jul 16 (0.16 migration) is the second suspect (naga). Freed 2.3GB stale Debug app binary. Verification protocol: next boot slow (miss+write), boot after should be fast. Durable fix proposed: tree-shake ground composition per used-material-set (req_3400 pattern, already proven for regions).

resolution: Answered the boot shader wall: every dev-host boot compiles TWO megashader-class WGSL modules on the render thread (~95s each) — the 734KB Effect fill catalog and the 747KB painted-ground pipeline, both deliberately composing all 410 material fns. These compiles are old (ground since Jun 13); what changed is the RADV disk cache stopped absorbing them across boots. Primary cause: disk at 100% (886MB free) makes Mesa cache writes fail silently (verified no free-space handling in mesa disk_cache source); secondary suspect: the Jul 16 wgpu-native repin (naga). Freed 2.3GB (stale Debug app binary) so cache writes can land; verification is two boots (first still slow=miss+write, second fast). Proposed durable fix: tree-shake the ground formula per used-material set exactly like req_3400 did for regions. No code changed beyond disk cleanup; live regions confirmed innocent.
